assets.alt_text: Two types of propolis collector traps beside harvested raw propolis
assets.caption: Propolis collector traps and harvested raw propolis. Flexible or perforated collection surfaces give bees controlled gaps to fill with resin, helping separate commercial trap propolis from indiscriminate hive scrapings.
assets.credit: Source: Šuran et al., Figure 1, Molecules 26 (2021), 2930, CC BY 4.0.
